summary: Coeur d'Alene TPA camp in 1920, Forest Service from 1923, L-4 tower in 1939; the tower is gone, and an August 2025 trip report found no footings, only ruins.

facts.status_note: The tower is gone. An August 2025 trip report found no tower footings, only the ruins of a cabin and a scant amount of other ruins at the site.

visit.trail_note: In an August 2025 trip report, a hiking party walked the last stretch after a large section of road was still under deep snow.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Idaho lookout site spells the lookout's name Cory; the 1928 newspaper report quoted on the Shoshone County list spells it Corey. Both describe the 19-year-old killed by lightning on Marble Mountain.

notes_for_editor: Coordinates differ: the record uses the FFLA point 47.15075, -116.03253; Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 47.15195, -116.02346, about 0.7 km away. No source here says which point is the tower. Elevation is 6,300 ft (about 1,920 m) in two sources; the record has none. Not to be confused with the Washington lookout also named Marble Mountain (Ferry County, FFLOS US 548). The account rests on one August 2025 trip report. Story stays brief because the sources are thin.
